# Ageniqs - Enterprise AI Solutions

> Ageniqs is the U.S. growth arm of The Data Point, specializing in enterprise AI commercialization and custom agentic solutions.

## What We Do

We don't sell software. We deliver outcomes.

Ageniqs bridges the gap between advanced AI engineering and real-world business adoption. We help organizations identify high-impact AI opportunities, implement intelligent automation, and deploy production-ready AI systems that drive measurable operational and revenue outcomes.

## Our Solutions

### The Data Point
AI workflow platform that models any business process and automates it end-to-end - no builder, no admin console, delivered where your people already work: Microsoft Teams.

**The Problem:**
Every business runs on manual workflows nobody has time to fix - onboarding buried in email threads, approvals stuck in an inbox, institutional knowledge trapped in one person's head. The fix exists, but it's built for engineers to configure. Most companies don't have engineers to spare.

**How It Works:**
1. We Consult - Map your real workflows: overhead, bottlenecks, pain points costing time and money
2. We Model - Build automation inside our admin layer, your team never touches it
3. You Benefit - Your people work immediately inside Microsoft Teams, with a Data Point consultant on call in the channel

**Proven First in HR:**
HRtBeat - Hiring, onboarding, payroll, benefits, and every other HR question or workflow automated entirely inside Microsoft Teams, built on The Data Point platform. HR is the proof. Loan processing, real estate appraisals, manufacturing, facilities, and IT are your opportunities.

**Pricing:**
- Pay for What You Use - No bloated licenses or idle seats, only pay for automation actually running
- Consulting That Pays You Back - Setup spend converts into usage credit
- Every Project Gets You More - Shared library means faster rollouts and lower cost as we automate more of your business

### HRtBeat AI
Transform HR operations with AI-powered insights, automation, and intelligent workflows designed for modern enterprises.

### Custom AI Solutions
Bespoke agentic AI systems engineered for unique business challenges, combining automation and intelligent decision-making. Production-ready solutions designed for real operational environments.

## Key Concepts

**Enterprise AI Commercialization:** Transforming advanced AI capabilities into deployable business solutions
**Agentic AI:** AI systems that autonomously gather information, coordinate stakeholders, and trigger actions
**Workflow Automation:** End-to-end business process automation inside existing tools like Microsoft Teams
**Outcome-Based Delivery:** Focus on measurable operational and revenue results, not just software deployment
**Human-in-the-Loop:** AI handles coordination while humans retain control of critical business decisions
**No-Code Platform:** Business users can operate sophisticated AI workflows without engineering resources
